title: get_api_deals_with_various_filters_and_pagination
description: Verify GET /api/deals endpoint returns correct discounted product lists with various combinations of search, brand, category, price range, sortBy, page, and pageSize parameters, including validation error handling for invalid inputs.

title: get_api_products_with_filters_and_sorting
description: Verify GET /api/products endpoint returns full product grid data correctly with onlyDiscounted=false and various filter and sort parameters, including handling unknown brand/category filters and restrictive price ranges.

title: get_api_products_id_and_price_history_endpoints
description: Verify GET /api/products/{id} returns product details correctly for valid IDs and 404 for unknown or missing IDs; verify GET /api/products/{id}/price-history returns correct price history data for valid days parameter and validation errors for invalid days.

title: get_api_products_sparklines_with_id_limit
description: Verify GET /api/products/sparklines returns sparkline data for up to 100 product IDs and returns validation error when exceeding the ID limit.

title: get_api_brand_comparison_with_valid_and_invalid_brands
description: Verify GET /api/brand-comparison returns category-based average price comparison data for valid brand pairs and returns appropriate error responses for unknown or missing brand parameters.

title: get_api_coupons_active_and_empty_states
description: Verify GET /api/coupons returns active coupon codes correctly and returns an empty list when no active coupons exist.

title: get_api_articles_list_and_detail
description: Verify GET /api/articles returns the list of guide articles and GET /api/articles/{slug} returns article details for valid slugs and 404 for unknown slugs.

title: get_api_filters_returns_brands_and_categories
description: Verify GET /api/filters returns the current list of available brands and categories, including handling empty lists when no data is available.

title: get_api_stats_returns_homepage_statistics
description: Verify GET /api/stats returns homepage statistics data correctly for initial site experience.

title: get_go_productid_redirects_to_store
description: Verify GET /go/{productId} endpoint correctly increments click counter and issues a 302 redirect to the store URL for valid product IDs.

title: post_api_subscribe_valid_and_invalid_email
description: Verify POST /api/subscribe returns 200 with a generic confirmation message for a valid email format, and 400 for a malformed email (e.g. 'not-an-email'). Do not assert on actual email delivery — no email provider is configured in this environment.

title: post_api_products_id_watch_valid_and_invalid
description: Verify POST /api/products/{id}/watch returns 200 for a valid product id and email format, and 404 for a non-existent product id.

title: post_and_delete_api_products_id_favorite
description: Verify POST /api/products/{id}/favorite returns 200 with a token for a new email, and DELETE /api/products/{id}/favorite?token=... removes it. Also verify GET /api/favorites?token=... reflects the change.

title: post_api_favorites_recover_unknown_email
description: Verify POST /api/favorites/recover returns 200 with a generic message regardless of whether the email is registered (must not leak whether an email exists in the system).

title: post_api_products_id_vote
description: Verify POST /api/products/{id}/vote with {"helpful": true} and {"helpful": false} returns 200 for a valid product id, and 404 for a non-existent product id.
